Inline empty-state pill row + collapsed single pill after first send + modal for "See all" / full-detail browsing.

Empty state. No messages yet. The full pill row is visible above the chat input. Hover any pill to preview the full prompt. Click a pill to insert it into the textarea. Click + See all to open the modal.
After first message. The pill row collapses to a single pill (💡 Sample prompts ▼) so it stays available but doesn't crowd the input. Click the pill to re-expand the row.
Full-detail modal. Opened from + See all in the pill row. Filter by All / Triggers advisor / Skips advisor. Click anywhere on a card to expand the full prompt body in-place. Click the + button on a card to insert that prompt into the textarea and close the modal.

UX summary:
• Inline pill row — hover a pill for a tooltip preview, click a pill to insert.
• + See all (N) pill → opens the modal with filter chips + full preview cards.
• In the modal: click anywhere on a card → expands the full prompt body in-place. Click the + button → inserts the prompt and closes the modal.
• Filter chips (All / Triggers advisor / Skips advisor) replace a free-text search — the library is small and the categories are fixed, so chips are clearer than search.
• Color coding: green = triggers advisor; amber = skips advisor (matches the app's existing --eval-accent / --adv-solo palette color, so it's on-brand). Red was considered but rejected — "skips" isn't bad, just a different category.
• Complexity meter (3 bars to the left of each title) — directional guidance, not a real cost estimate. ▪ = Quick (~500–2k tokens), ▪▪ = Standard (~3–8k tokens), ▪▪▪ = Heavy (~10–25k tokens, ~3× in compare-all-three mode). Hover the meter for the tooltip.
• Why not a real cost estimate? Advisor calls fire at runtime based on the executor's judgment — we can't know in advance whether the advisor will fire, how many times, or how long the outputs will be. Any single dollar figure shown here would mislead more than help.
• Confirm-replace protects against accidental overwrites if the textarea already has text.
• After first send, the row collapses to a single 💡 Sample prompts ▾ pill that re-expands on click.
• ▾ collapse arrow in the row header → user can manually collapse the row even before sending.
• Schema: public/sample-prompts.json → { prompts: [{ title, prompt, shouldTriggerAdvisor }] }.
